earlier_scan.source_named: Glottolog classifies Tawende as unattested and extinct; no description exists.

sources.citation: Glottolog 5.x languoid record tawe1235 (HTML + JSON) and reference record 37160; Nambiquaran family newick tree (namb1299).
sources.note: Category 'Unattested', hid NOCODE_Tawende, parent 'Nambiquaran (Unattested)' (namb1301), AES 10 extinct, no coordinates; single med entry [37160, 'a wordlist or less', Eberhard 2009: 21-31]. The attested-family tree (namb1299) does not contain Tawendê; Tawandê (tawa1278, ISO xtw) is a different Roosevelt-cluster language. Confirms that no descriptive source exists.

sources.note: Fabre's Nambikwara bibliography has no Tawendê/Sowaintê entry (only 'Sawentesu', a Southern Nambikwara group). Santana 2010 (tawa1278 folder) describes Tawandê /taʔwanʔtu/, explicitly a different language per Eberhard 2009 fn.26. Nothing on Tawendê.
